item.description:
Edge guides

  • The guides along the screen's edges now have a two-tone outline, a white line inside a dark one, so they're easy to see on light, dark and colorful backgrounds alike.
  • The guides in each corner are drawn as one piece, with no lines crossing where they meet.
  • With Increase contrast, Reduce transparency or Differentiate without color turned on in System Settings → Accessibility → Display, every guide is drawn solid and the one under the pointer gets a thicker white line.
